name: Tenant Settings
description: Per-tenant key-value settings store — every method is tenant-scoped and rows carry tenantId. Modules declare their keys in *.setting.keys.ts; the service stores/reads them. Also hosts the admin settings console and per-tenant module enable/disable (module-activation).
author: Kuray Karaaslan

extensionPoints.description: Who reviews a setting change while the tenant's maker-checker is on (`tenantSettingMakerChecker`). Default export: SettingChangeReviewer { submit(tenantId, { key, value, encrypted, actorId }) => Promise<{ reviewId }> }; the value is stored encrypted for a secret key. The approval module contributes it (the shared approval queue) and, on a terminal decision, calls tenant_setting's applySettingChangeDecision from its own approval-phase boot task. The first active reviewer is used. Fails closed: with maker-checker on and no active reviewer (approval missing or off for the tenant) the write is refused with 409 before anything is saved, because maker-checker is a security control. Declared here so tenant_setting never imports approval, which requires it.

An extra entry on the settings overview (/admin/settings), in the Access & Security grid. Implemented through the CLIENT slot 'tenant_setting.settings.links': a contributor declares slots[] = { slot: 'tenant_setting.settings.links', component, order, scope: 'tenant' }. Props received: { tenantId }. The contribution renders its own link card and decides itself whether it applies (it may render nothing, e.g. the fleet node's residency facts off a node). Declared so tenant_setting never imports the satellite that owns the page.
